text.p: ModaCAD Inc Wednesday said a registration statement on Form S-3, as required to reflect current financial and other information, covering the registration of the common stock issuable upon exercise of the company's outstanding publicly traded warrants to purchase shares at a price of $6.50 per share has been declared effective by the Securities and Exchange Commission.

The company also said its board of directors had decided to exercise the company's right to redeem the outstanding warrants. Warrantholders will have 30 days following notification of redemption from the company's warrant agent to exercise their warrants before they are redeemed.
If any warrant called for redemption is not exercised by such time, it will cease to be exercisable and its holder will be entitled only to receive the redemption price of $0.01 per warrant.
